report:
Antecedentes Clínicos:
Tendinitis.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y de la tróclea femoral sin alteraciones. Fina
úlcera condral focal de espesor total de la faceta lateral de la rótula, sin significativos cambios
óseos secundarios.
No hay signos que sugieran derrame articular o sinovitis. No hay quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal en inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital. Tendón rotuliano, tendones de
la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Discreto edema el paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano.
Discreto edema las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Impresión:
Fina condropatía focal grado 4 de la faceta lateral de la rótula.
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal.
Discreto edema del paquete adiposo retro cuadricipital suprarrotuliano, hallazgo inespecífico.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial

In the medial compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn. There is focal high grade chondral defect at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about intact4* intact4 cm).  
 The patellofemoral joint, there is focal high grade chondrosis (more than 50% thickness cartilage loss) with subchondral edema at the medial patellar facet (about 1.4* 1.6 cm) and medial trochlea (about NC/NA*1.7 cm). The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact  
 In the intercondylar notch, the anterior cruciate ligament is intact The posterior cruciate ligament is intact There is no anterior tibial translation. 
 The medial collateral ligamentous complexes are intact The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact  
 The lateral collateral ligament complexes are intact The popliteofibular ligament is intact The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Minimal right knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal.  Focal high grade chondral defect at the posterolateral tibial plateau (about intact4* intact4 cm) of right knee.  
  Focal high grade chondrosis with subchondral edema at the medial patellar facet (about 1.4* 1.6 cm) and medial trochlea (about NC/NA*1.7 cm). 
  Minimal right knee effusion.

COMPARISON:None.

CLINICAL HISTORY:Left knee pain, suspected meniscal tear.

PROCEDURE:Multisequence multiplanar unenhanced MRI of the left knee according to routine protocol.

IMAGING FINDINGS:

Nondiagnostic scout localizing images reviewed.

The medial meniscus is intact with the lateral meniscus is intact. 

Intact anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament.

The medial collateral ligament and posterior oblique ligament are intact. Moderate fluid accumulation within the pes anserine bursa.

The fibular collateral ligament and popliteus tendon attachments are intact. Biceps femoris tendon insertion is intact. Iliotibial band is intact.

The patellar retinacula are intact. No femoral trochlear dysplasia. The TT-TG distance measures 8 mm, within normal limits. The quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact. Focal full thickness cartilage denuding medial patellar facet near the patellar apex. Mild chondrosis throughout the remainder of the patellofemoral compartment. Preserved medial femorotibial articular cartilage. Tiny focus of full-thickness cartilage denuding central weightbearing aspect lateral tibial plateau.

Trace joint fluid. Regional musculature is within normal limits. No suspicious focal marrow signal alteration.

IMPRESSION:
1. No evidence of meniscal tear.
2. Moderate pes anserine bursitis.
3. Mild to moderate patellofemoral chondrosis and a tiny focus of high-grade chondrosis lateral tibial plateau. Findings may reflect evolving mild patellofemoral predominant osteoarthritis of the left knee.

Trouvailles:

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire avec un kyste poplité non rupturé.

Il y a des amincissements légers à modérés du cartilage au niveau patello-fémoral, impliquant la rotule et la trochlée du fémur. Il n'y a pas de région de perte de cartilage complet. Le cartilage du compartiment interne et externe est sans particularité. 

Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le ménisque interne, le ménisque externe, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps femoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion:

1- Changements dégénératifs patello-fémoraux, sans région de perte de cartilage complet.

2- Autrement, examen sans particularité. Il n'y a pas de déchirure méniscale ou de blessure ligamentaire.

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: 6 weeks of right knee pain.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Small joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: High-grade cartilage loss at the weightbearing surface of the lateral femoral condyle with focal full-thickness defect measuring 5 x 4 mm with associated subchondral cystic change and marrow edema. Focal full-thickness fissure at the posterior nonweightbearing aspect of the lateral femoral condyle with subchondral cystic change. High grade fissuring along the lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis. No tendon tear. There is associated edema at the quadriceps fat pad.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 12 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
1.	Lateral compartment chondrosis. 
2.	Mild distal quadriceps insertional tendinosis with associated edema at the quadriceps fat pad.
3.	Small joint effusion.

SOL DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Lateral menisküs normaldir.  Medial menisküs posterior hornunda volüm kaybı ve kompleks yırtık izlendi. Medial menisküs yaklaşık 4.5 mm laterale ekstrüde izlendi.Arka çapraz bağ, lateral  kollateral ligaman normaldir. Ön çapraz bağda diffüz sinyal artışıı ve dejenerasyon mevcuttur(mukoid dejenerasyon). Medial kollateral ligaman çevresinde sıvı artışı izlendi.Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur. Patellar kıkırdak medial fasette yer yer fissür hatları izlendi(tip II kondromalazi).Suprapatellar bursada ve diz ekleminde hafif  sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Diz eklemini oluşturan kemik yapılarda osteofitik değişiklikler özellikle medialde tibiofemoral  eklem mesafesinde daralma , tibiofemoral kartilajlarda bütünlük kaybı  subkondral skleroz bulguları izlenmiştir ( dejeneratif artrit bulguları ). Ayrıca tibial medial plato düzeyinde subkondral kist ve kemik iliği ödemi izlendi.Tibiofemoral eklem içerisinde  8 mm çapta  cisim izlendi(loose body). Komşuluğunda 15x10 mm boyutlarında septalı iç yapıda kistik lezyon izlendi(ganglion kisti).

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia bilateral.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones en significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales sin alteraciones significativas.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior del menisco medial que no impresiona contactar
con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
Úlceras condrales de espesor parcial y total de la zona de carga del compartimento femorotibial
lateral sin cambios óseos secundarios. Cartílagos del compartimento femorotibial medial sin
alteraciones. Úlceras condrales focales de espesor total de la región central de la vertiente medial
de la tróclea femoral con discretos cambios óseos secundarios. Condropatía rotuliana superficial
difusa.
Leve derrame articular con sinovitis difusa. No hay quistes poplíteos.
Leve aumento de señal de la inserción proximal del tendón rotuliano. Cambios entesopáticos
cuadricipitales distales. Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de
límites normales. Discreto edema las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral
lateral.
No hay alteraciones de señal de la grasa de Hoffa.
Impresión:
Condropatía lesiones grado 3 de la zona de carga del compartimento femorotibial lateral.
Condropatía con lesiones grado 3 y 4 de la tróclea femoral. Condropatía rotuliana superficial
difusa.
Leve derrame articular con sinovitis difusa.
Leve tendinosis rotuliana proximal. Cambios entesopáticos cuadricipitales distales.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda iliotibial

МР находка: МР данни за лезия на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3. В него се изобразява хиперинтензна линия с хоризонтален ход, която достига до края на менискуса и до ставния хрущял. До него се изобразява киста с големина 4/3мм. Нормално изобразяване на предния рог на медиалния менискус, както и на предния и задния рог на латералния менискус. Костите, формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма. Вижда се дискретен костномозъчен едем в областта на медиалния кондил на тибията. Не се намират изменения в хрущяла на фемура, тибията  пателата. Кръстни връзки – интактни. Колатерални лигаменти, ретинакулуми на пателата – нормално изобразяване. Сухожилие на мускулус квадрицепс феморис, лигамент на пателата – без особености. Поплитеална ямка - б.о. Наличие на фабела. Няма данни за ставен излив. Изобразява се леко изразен едем в подкожието на предната повърхност на подбедрицата и колянната става. Заключение: МР данни за лезия и киста на задния рог на медиалния менискус – grade 3.

Findings: There is a mild knee effusion. There is incomplete tearing of the posterior root of the medial meniscus. Normal lateral meniscus.  Mild myxoid degeneration of the ACL is noted. Normal PCL, MCL and LCL. Normal extensor mechanism.  There is mild thinning and fraying of the medial compartment articular cartilage. The lateral tibiofemoral and patellofemoral articular cartilage is normal.  
Conclusion: Incomplete tearing of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. Mild medial compartment articular cartilage degeneration.
